Sleepwalker is a tall, emaciated humanoid entity that appears to be an elderly person wandering aimlessly at night. Its body is unnaturally thin, with loose skin and long limbs that bend in unsettling ways. What looks like its closed eyes are actually false features; its real eyes sit higher on the face, while its true mouth is hidden lower, remaining unseen until it attacks.

The creature moves slowly and quietly, imitating the behavior of a sleepwalking human to avoid suspicion. It is often seen in places where people are vulnerable, blending in long enough to get close to its victims. When it reveals its true nature, its jaw stretches wide, its throat expands, and its joints twist backward, allowing it to move with sudden speed and consume its prey whole.
